value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text: Fixed all three by hand on #107. (1) PRRT_kwDOTqJmqs6x8fDu stopTrainer: an unreadable birth identity counts as stopped only when kill(pid, 0) reports ESRCH, and an unreadable identity after SIGKILL is not proof of stop. New assertion in controller-boundaries 'recovery stops only the exact live trainer' fails on revert (0/1). (2) PRRT_kwDOTqJmqs6x8fDs fixed-result read path: the result must follow the plan, every collection Run and the candidate, via the shared fixedLifecycleArtifacts. New test 'fixed results created before their collection Run and candidate never promote' fails on revert (0/1). Legitimate recording always verifies Runs and candidate first, so no released result can have the old ordering. (3) PRRT_kwDOTqJmqs6x8fDn: the stale public_node_and_bun copy now references docs/sequential-evaluation-evidence.json (same commit, snapshot and comparison, current evidence_digest). Also fixed: the 'git absent from PATH' CLI test and evaluation-plan.acceptance now link the platform identity tool, because the merged process-job fence needs getconf/ps (the test failed at e0fb7d9 with process_identity_unavailable).

value.text: CodeRabbit round on 0a9a36c (4 minor), fixed by hand. (1) Git discovery validates only the .git marker, so standalone trackers below symlinked ancestors (macOS /var, linked /home) are no longer refused; a linked marker is still rl_state_path_invalid. The new checkpoint-artifacts test fails on revert. The durable-loop alias launch now resolves to the same shared authority (exit 0), and the second worktree still gets loop_launch_elsewhere. (2) Checkpoint-producing entry points (improver run, prefix meta recipes, prefix process fits) refuse checkpoint_storage_unsupported before any reservation, lease or receipt; the new mutation-preflight test fails when each of the three preflights is reverted separately. README documents the restriction. (3) The two sequential-evaluation tests start try right after setting PM_LOCK_WAIT_MS. (4) Card export and replay share citationOrder (UTF-8 bytes). It is unreachable today: native IDs are lowercase [a-z0-9-], pm rejects é and _, and 200k fuzzed pairs give identical code-unit and collation order. Unified to remove the latent mismatch. Suites: mutation-preflight + checkpoint-artifacts 44/44, policy-card replay 4/4, durable-loop alias 1/1; check (0 clones), docstring 499, lint, changelog pass.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text: CI on 4e9dbd5 (main merged) failed 5 tests on Node 26. Bisected locally: four already failed at e0fb7d9 (both staging tests, the shadow git-absent test and the transition boundary property); one was mine. Fixed: (1) Reverted my fixed-result ordering in readEvaluationDecision, because 'fixed results retain pre-candidate sealing' pins that a fixed result may be sealed before its Runs and candidate and must only follow the declaration. CodeRabbit thread 8fDs conflicted with that design, and I removed my contrary test. (2) statePath treats ENOTDIR from lstat as absent instead of a link refusal, so a regular-file ancestor surfaces as the caller's own ENOTDIR and the staging failure releases and fails the reservation (both staging tests pass). The corpus case 'root below a regular file' is corpus_source_missing again. (3) The shadow git-absent CLI test links the platform identity tool. Remaining: transition boundary property at step_applied with ABA (the post-commit inspect sees an identical body), queued as a codex continuation. Corpus, state-boundary, checkpoint-artifacts and evaluation-plan 90/90; the four fixed tests pass; check (0 clones), lint, docstring and changelog pass.
